summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate funding, emphasizing its essential role in supporting modern public education and the need to maintain connectivity for students.

claims.argument: E-Rate covers 90% of Category One costs and 85% of Category Two costs for Steger School District 194
claims.evidence_quote: For Steger School District 194, E-Rate covers 90% of our Category One costs and 85% of our Category Two costs. From funding years 2021–2025, our district received $497,249 in committed E-Rate support—approximately $99,450 per year.
